scope: Counter-only fulloriginal-input runs, separate from clean andCPU/GC observers. Retained type names plus actualshapes, not all semantic roles: legacy eqref arrays carry arguments/environments/publicvectors; canonicalizednumericstructs may carryboxes orcaptures. Constructor totals are reachedrequests, not physicalallocation.

rows.scope: Full invocation including initialization/checking, function bodies only; constant global initializers excluded.
rows.caveat: Counts mark reached sites before operand evaluation, including possible failed/aborted operands. They are not completed operations or physical allocations. Scalar boxes do not establish concrete container/capture storage. Instrumentation changes optimization; timings are excluded.
